list.title: Employees
list.text: Who can sign in to {{business}} and what they can do.
list.errorText: Check your connection and try again.
list.cancelText: The link in their email stops working. You can invite them again later.
list.deactivateText: They can’t sign in until you reactivate them. Their past sales and shifts stay as they are.
list.emptyText: Invite cashiers and staff so every sale and shift is recorded under the right name. It’s optional — you can sell on your own.

invite.title: Invite employee
invite.text: Give your team their own sign-in so every sale and shift is recorded under the right name.
invite.usernameHint: 3–100 characters. They’ll sign in with it.
invite.emailHint: We send the invitation and temporary sign-in details here.

roles.adminText: Manages the business, products, stock and employees.
roles.cashierText: Opens shifts and sells at the POS.
roles.inventoryStaffText: Counts and adjusts stock. No selling.

invite.passwordNote: You don’t set their password. They get temporary sign-in details and choose their own password the first time they sign in.
invite.optionalNote: Employee invitations are optional. You can sell on your own and invite staff later.
invite.fixOne: Fix 1 field to send the invitation. Everything you typed is kept.
invite.fixMany: Fix {{count}} fields to send the invitation. Everything you typed is kept.

errors.usernamePattern: Use letters, numbers, dots, dashes or underscores only.
errors.usernameTaken: Someone in your business already uses this username.
errors.emailInvalid: Enter a valid email, like name@example.com.
errors.emailTaken: This email already belongs to someone in your business.
errors.limitReached: You’ve reached your plan’s employee limit. Deactivate someone or upgrade your plan to invite more.
errors.failed: We couldn’t send the invitation. Check your connection and try again.

details.errorText: Check your connection and try again.
details.invitedText: Invitation sent to {{email}} on {{date}}. They join once they accept it.

roleHints.admin: Manages products, branches, employees and reports.
roleHints.cashier: Sells on the POS, opens and closes shifts, and looks up customers.
roleHints.inventoryStaff: Manages products and stock counts. Can’t sell or see reports.
roleHints.owner: Created the business. Has every permission.

details.roleYou: You can't change your own role.
details.roleFailed: Couldn't change the role. Try again.
details.noShiftsText: Their shifts show here once they open one on the POS.
